about: A desktop app for small businesses and freelancers to make invoices and quotes.

prs.title: E-invoice totals now add up to the cent
prs.broken: Exported e-invoices could have totals off by one cent, like 17.50 plus 3.33 VAT shown as 20.82, so invoice validators rejected them.
prs.changed: Every total is now built from the same rounded amounts the invoice lines already use.
prs.matters: Invoices pass the checks that governments and buyers run on them.
